source_request: [$photo-prompt-image-generator](/Users/chasoik/Projects/image-prompt/skills/photo-prompt-image-generator/SKILL.md) 보름달에 겹쳐 빗자루를 타고 날아가는 미소녀 마녀
interpreted_intent: A cinematic photorealistic fantasy scene using the attached portrait as the adult woman's appearance reference, with her witch-and-broom figure visibly crossing the full moon.
subject: An unmistakably adult young East Asian woman matching the attached portrait, portrayed as an elegant witch.
setting: A clear nocturnal sky above a faint cloud layer and distant sleeping town lights, dominated by an enormous luminous full moon.
event: The adult witch flies side-on on a wooden broom directly across the face of the full moon.
visual_priorities: The complete woman-and-broom figure clearly overlaps the center of the full-moon disc.
The adult woman's facial appearance remains recognizable from the attached portrait while the action reads clearly.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic photorealistic night photograph of an unmistakably adult young East Asian woman portrayed as an elegant witch, with the same delicate oval face, pale beige-blonde hair with airy fringe, gray-brown eyes, and soft rose makeup as the attached portrait. She flies side-on across a clear night sky on a wooden broom; her complete seated figure and the entire broom overlap the center of an enormous luminous full moon. Her long hair, pointed black hat, fitted midnight-blue dress, short cape, and ribbons stream backward in the wind. One hand grips the broom while the other steadies her hat, and she wears a calm, delighted smile. The moon creates a bright circular backlight and crisp silver rim light around her silhouette while retaining readable facial features, costume texture, and broom bristles. Far below, a faint cloud layer and tiny sleeping-town lights establish height. Use dynamic diagonal motion, realistic anatomy, natural fabric movement, subtle atmospheric haze, and a polished fantasy-editorial photographic finish.
